units: metres; one map tile is 10 x 10 m; Y is up; the model's origin sits at the centre of its footprint on the ground
style: Stylized low-poly 3D game asset for a cozy modern city-builder. Clean chunky shapes, slightly toy-like proportions, flat matte colours with a subtle hand-painted texture, readable from a high three-quarter camera. One isolated object, centred, standing on a flat base. No surrounding terrain, no text, no logos, no people.
texture_style: Soft matte hand-painted colours, gentle ambient occlusion, no baked shadows on the ground, no text or logos.

groups.name: Residential zone
groups.note: Grows by itself on green zones. Low density stops at level 3, high density goes to level 6. The building faces the road on its front (-Z) side.

items.name: Cottage (level 1)
items.prompt: A small one-storey suburban cottage with cream walls, a red gable roof with a short overhang, two small square windows per wall, a front door, and a small round garden tree beside it.

items.name: Family house (low density, level 2)
items.prompt: A two-storey detached family house, pastel rendered walls, dark brown pitched gable roof, regular grid of white-framed windows, a porch over the front door, compact box shape.

items.name: Townhouse terrace (low density, level 3)
items.prompt: A row of three joined three-storey townhouses with a flat roof and a slightly darker parapet, each with its own front door and tall windows, alternating cream, pale pink and sage facades.

items.name: Brick walk-up (high density, levels 2-3)
items.prompt: A three-to-four storey red-brick apartment walk-up filling its square lot, flat roof with a darker coping, a regular grid of tall windows on every face, a simple entrance with steps at the front.

items.name: Apartment tower (high density, levels 4-6)
items.prompt: A slender residential apartment tower, pale concrete with a dense grid of windows and small balconies, a setback upper storey and a boxy rooftop plant room. Square footprint, very tall and narrow.

groups.name: Commercial zone
groups.note: Shops up to level 3, glass towers on dense lots from level 4.

items.name: Corner shop (levels 1-3)
items.prompt: A small high-street shop building, one to three storeys, a wide glowing shop window across the ground floor, a coloured striped awning over it, flat roof with a box-shaped illuminated sign on top.

items.name: Commercial tower (dense, levels 4-6)
items.prompt: A modern glass commercial skyscraper on a wider two-storey podium, blue-grey metal frame with continuous horizontal glass bands on every floor, a glowing coloured box on the flat roof. Square footprint, tall.

items.name: Workshop (low density)
items.prompt: A small industrial workshop, tan corrugated-metal shed with a sawtooth roof of three skylight ridges, one brick smokestack with a red band at the top, a stack of wooden crates in the yard.

items.name: Heavy factory (dense, level 3+)
items.prompt: A heavy-industry factory hall, tall grey corrugated building with a sawtooth roof, three tapering concrete smokestacks of different heights with red bands near the top, and a white cylindrical storage tank beside it.

items.name: Office block (levels 1-3)
items.prompt: A mid-rise modern office block, dark steel-blue frame with ribbon windows wrapping every floor, flat roof with a thin darker coping. Square footprint, two to six storeys.

items.name: Office skyscraper (levels 4-6)
items.prompt: A tiered glass office skyscraper: a tall square base and a narrower upper tier, glass curtain walls with a floor grid, topped either with a pointed pyramid crown or a slim antenna mast with a red warning light.

items.name: Coal plant
items.prompt: A compact coal power station on a concrete pad: two grey hyperbolic cooling towers at the back, a red-brick turbine hall with tall windows at the front, one tall thin chimney, and a black coal heap.

items.name: Gas plant
items.prompt: A clean modern gas-fired power plant on a concrete pad: a long light-grey turbine hall with two slim exhaust stacks on its roof, and three white round gas storage tanks in a row at the front.

items.name: Wind turbine (tower and nacelle)
items.prompt: A white wind turbine tower: a tall tapering cylindrical mast on a small square concrete base with a boxy nacelle on top. No blades: the rotor is a separate model.

items.name: Wind turbine rotor (animated)
items.prompt: A white three-bladed wind turbine rotor with a rounded hub, blades evenly spaced at 120 degrees, flat and facing forward. Rotor only, no tower.

items.name: Solar farm
items.prompt: A small solar farm: ten rows of dark blue tilted photovoltaic panels on thin metal legs, arranged in two columns on a square patch of dry grass with gravel paths between them.

items.name: Nuclear plant
items.prompt: A nuclear power station on a concrete pad: two large pale hyperbolic cooling towers, a white cylindrical reactor containment building with a domed top, and a grey rectangular turbine hall with a band of windows.

items.name: Water pump
items.prompt: A small water pumping station on a concrete pad: a pale blue pump house with a darker blue gable roof, and a rectangular open reservoir pool of clear blue water beside it.

items.name: Water tower
items.prompt: A classic water tower: a light-blue cylindrical steel tank with a shallow conical roof, raised high on four slightly splayed grey steel legs with cross-bracing.

items.name: Water treatment
items.prompt: A water treatment works on a concrete pad: three round concrete settling tanks filled with blue-green water, and a white single-storey control building with a band of windows and a blue roof.

items.name: Police station
items.prompt: A two-storey police station, pale blue-grey walls with a dark blue band around the top of the walls, rows of windows, a flagpole with a blue flag on the roof corner, and a blue lamp by the entrance.

items.name: Fire station
items.prompt: A two-storey red-brick fire station with a white band around the top, a large white roller door for the fire engine on the ground floor, upstairs windows, and a flagpole with a red flag on the roof corner.

items.name: Clinic
items.prompt: A small two-storey medical clinic, clean white walls with a red band around the top, rows of windows, and a red cross sign lying on the flat roof.

items.name: Hospital
items.prompt: A white modern hospital: a wide two-storey base building with a narrower six-storey tower rising from its centre, regular window grid, and a large red cross helipad marking on the tower roof.

items.name: School
items.prompt: An L-shaped two-storey red-brick school with a dark grey pitched roof, many windows, a flagpole with a blue flag, and a small sports pitch with a red running track filling the inside corner of the L.

items.name: University
items.prompt: A sandstone university campus: three connected three-storey stone buildings with green-grey pitched roofs forming a U around a lawn quadrangle, and a tall square clock tower with a pyramid roof and a lit clock face.

items.name: Park
items.prompt: A small square neighbourhood park on bright green lawn: three round and conical trees, a sandy footpath straight across the middle, and a wooden bench.

items.name: Plaza
items.prompt: A square paved town plaza in warm beige stone with a round shallow fountain basin in the centre and a small spout column, and a small tree in each of the four corners.

items.name: Playground
items.prompt: A children's playground on a square of soft sand: a red climbing tower with a blue pointed roof, a yellow slide coming down from it, a grey metal swing frame, and one small tree.

items.name: Sports field
items.prompt: A square grass sports pitch with white boundary and halfway lines, a small white goal at each end, and four tall floodlight masts at the corners.

items.name: Stadium
items.prompt: A compact open-air football stadium: four stepped grandstands with coloured seats enclosing a green pitch, light grey concrete outer walls, and four tall floodlight towers at the corners.

items.name: Town hall
items.prompt: A neoclassical town hall in pale cream stone: a two-storey block with a row of six white columns across the front portico, a round drum on the roof topped by a green copper dome and a flagpole with a red flag.

items.name: Monument
items.prompt: A tall white stone obelisk monument with a pyramid tip, standing on a low square stepped plinth in the middle of a small paved square.

items.name: Airport
items.prompt: A small regional airport: a dark asphalt runway with white centre dashes along one side, a grey apron, a long low glass-fronted terminal building, and a slim control tower with a glass cab on top.

groups.name: Props and street life
groups.note: Small, repeated many times, so keep them very low-poly (target 300-1500 triangles).

items.name: Broadleaf tree
items.prompt: A stylised round broadleaf tree with a short brown trunk and a puffy, chunky green canopy.

items.name: Conifer
items.prompt: A stylised conifer tree, a stacked cone of dark green layers on a short brown trunk.

items.name: Street lamp
items.prompt: A simple modern street lamp: a slim dark grey pole with a short arm and a flat lamp head.

items.name: Power pole
items.prompt: A wooden utility power pole with one cross-arm and three small insulators on top. No wires.

items.name: Pylon (lines over water)
items.prompt: A small steel lattice electricity pylon with two cross-arms and insulators. No wires.

items.name: Car
items.prompt: A small generic hatchback car, rounded toy-like shape, white body (it gets re-tinted in game), dark windows, black wheels. Facing along its length.

items.name: City bus
items.prompt: A single-deck city bus, white body with a continuous dark window band along both sides, black wheels.

items.name: Pedestrian
items.prompt: A tiny stylised standing person, simple blocky body, white shirt (re-tinted in game), dark trousers, arms at the sides.

items.name: Parked airliner
items.prompt: A small white twin-engine passenger airliner with a red tail fin, landing gear down, parked.

items.name: Zoned lot sign
items.prompt: A small wooden post with a plain square white sign board on top (re-tinted in zone colour in game).

items.name: Burnt rubble
items.prompt: A low heap of charred dark grey rubble, broken concrete blocks and burnt beams on a square lot after a fire.

procedural: Ground, river and lake water, banks and the earth skirt around the map edge
Streets, avenues, bridges, sidewalks, zebra crossings and lane markings (they join up tile by tile)
Power line wires and water pipes
Window glow at night, overlays, the build cursor and parcel borders
Fire flames and all sound (synthesised in code)
